faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Government of Telangana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Government of Telangana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, 2 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Dietician, 1 Psychosocial Counselor, 1 Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Government of Telangana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (PDF) and send it to Room No 201, District Medical and Health Office, O/o District Collector and Magistrate, Nizamabad District. 503001, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹60,000 per month for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, ₹40,000 per month for AYUSH Medical Officer, ₹20,000 per month for Dietician, ₹500 per session, at least 200 visits in a year (on call) for Psychosocial Counselor, ₹28,000 per month for Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate, Master's degree, B.Sc, Diploma, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Reservation as per applicable Telangana rules and Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 03-11-2026 will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Outsourcing Basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nizamabad District.
